name: Stoneweg European REIT
summary: Stoneweg European REIT (CEREIT) operates as a real estate investment trust, with its core strategy centered on acquiring and managing a diverse collection of revenue-generating properties across Europe, either directly or through indirect investments. These assets primarily consist of office spaces, light industrial/logistics facilities, and retail units. As of the announcement date, CEREIT's extensive portfolio comprises 95 properties, boasting an appraised value of approximately €2,082 million. These holdings are strategically located in or near major urban centers across the Netherlands, Italy, France, Poland, Germany, Finland, and Denmark, with a balanced emphasis on both the office and light industrial/logistics sectors. The portfolio collectively offers about 1.4 million square meters of rentable area, serves nearly 800 tenant-customers, and, as of September 30, 2020, recorded a Weighted Average Lease Expiry (WALE3) of approximately 5.0 years. Notably, CEREIT holds the distinction of being the first diversified pan-European REIT to be listed on the Singapore Exchange Limited.
